name: ott-platform
description: OTT Platform (MERN): React client, Express server, MongoDB database

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix database
scripts.seed: npm run import --prefix database && npm run seed --prefix database
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
